notes.title: Fallen Arena's release date update
notes.notes:
We have important news regarding E4C: Fallen Arena's release we'd like to share with you today.

We are moving the actual launch date of E4C: Fallen Arena to December 23, 2022.

Ambrus Studio always wants to develop memorable gaming experiences with the player's experience at the core, and as the mini-game and the intro of the E4Cverse, Fallen Arena will give players the first taste of the world.We are currently at a stage where the game is complete and playable, but there's still work to be done. Due to the complexity of the whole system, we need more time to finish fixing and polishing, we postpone the launch, to give us precious time to make the game perfect.

Awakened Rangers, come to save the world and human civilization! Thank you for your ongoing support!
